references.text: This verse contains the original instruction from God to overlay the planks with gold and make gold rings as holders for the crossbars, as described in Exodus 36:34.
These verses give the instructions for the crossbars of acacia wood that were to go through the rings on the tabernacle's planks, which are carried out in Exodus 36:34.
These verses describe the making of the crossbars of acacia wood, which were then overlaid with gold as mentioned in verse 34.
This verse shows the same pattern of overlaying objects with gold, here the ark of the covenant, which parallels the gold overlaying of the planks and crossbars.
Solomon overlaid the inside of the temple with pure gold, reflecting the same practice of gold overlaying that was used on the tabernacle in Exodus 36:34.
